assets.name: waystation
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset for MUGONG, a polished East Asian wuxia action game. Rich hand-painted 2D anime game illustration, warm ink outlines, detailed material shading, antique ochre and forest jade palette. No letters, symbols, captions, UI, border, watermark, or modern objects. Wide landscape environment background for a peaceful roadside mountain waystation before a boss battle. Bamboo, distant misty Chinese peaks, a tiled wooden pavilion and warm red lanterns. Three practical service areas along a stone courtyard: left a herbal medicine counter with jars and bamboo herb drawers, center a travel merchant stall with cloth awning, baskets and cloth bundles, right a small blacksmith forge with glowing coals, anvil and tool racks. No people or animals. Readable charming wuxia setting, detailed but not busy, softer pale central area for UI overlays, natural daylight with a touch of forge amber. Panoramic composition, 1536 by 1024 or wider landscape.
